verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI has a first-party multi-agent applications guide. It documents agent delegation, where one agent calls another via tools and takes back control, and programmatic agent hand-off, where application code calls the next agent. It also documents graph-based control flow, which together cover subagents and handoffs inside one workflow. Its evals framework is explicitly positioned for testing multi-agent applications. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of multi-agent orchestration, and evidence of a role-based 'crew' abstraction or deeper detail on shared state across delegated agents.
